newsitem.title: FRANCE: Allianz France has 97.86 pct of DDV Rhin Moselle.
newsitem.headline: Allianz France has 97.86 pct of DDV Rhin Moselle.

text.p: Allianz Via Holding France, a unit of German insurer Allianz, said on Thursday it held 95.46 percent of the capital and 97.86 percent of the voting rights of Rhin et Moselle Assurances following its buyout offer which closed on December 24.
Allianz had until then 88.01 percent of the capital.
"Conditions now are in place to allow Allianz Via Holding France to launch an offer for the remaining shares," Allianz said in a statement.
Allianz Via Holding said the success of the operation would permit it to simplify the financial and legal structures of its non-life insurance companies.
